allIntro:
Follow five lessons to see how language models process text, connect information, predict and learn.
The suggested order builds one clear journey, but every lesson is available.
lesson1Incomplete: Complete the experiments before finishing Lesson 1.
completeAllFirst: All lessons are recommended before the challenge.
completeAllToUnlock: The Final Challenge is available now and works best after all five lessons.
finalTitle: Final Challenge: Language Model Escape Room
finalDesc: Bring together tokens, numbers, context, connections, prediction and training. Recommended after all five lessons.

1.title: How does a language model process text?

2.title: Which words can a language model see?
2.desc: Explore the context window and the text available to the model.

3.title: How does a language model connect words together?
3.desc: See how Tokens inside the Context Window combine information before the model predicts what comes next.

4.title: How does a language model choose what comes next?
4.desc: Compare possible next Tokens, their chances and one-Token-at-a-time generation.

5.title: How does a language model learn from examples?
5.desc: Follow prediction, correction and repetition to see how useful patterns are learned.
